interpretations: For each distinct `transref`, calculate the mean of its non-null `anlycount` values. Calculate the overall mean of those transaction means, excluding null means, and retain transactions whose mean exceeds it. Return each retained `transref`, its mean, its difference from the overall mean, and its difference from the mean of the retained transaction means. Sort by the last difference descending, with nulls last; return the first 10 rows and all rows tied with the 10th, without rounding.
queries:
WITH transaction_means AS (
    SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS mean_anlycount
    FROM sentimentandfundamentals
    GROUP BY transref
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(mean_anlycount) AS overall_mean
    FROM transaction_means
),
retained AS (
    SELECT tm.transref, tm.mean_anlycount, o.overall_mean
    FROM transaction_means AS tm
    CROSS JOIN overall AS o
    WHERE tm.mean_anlycount > o.overall_mean
),
differences AS (
    SELECT
        transref,
        mean_anlycount,
        mean_anlycount - overall_mean AS difference_from_overall_mean,
        mean_anlycount - AVG(mean_anlycount) OVER () AS difference_from_retained_mean
    FROM retained
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *,
           RANK() OVER (
               ORDER BY difference_from_retained_mean DESC NULLS LAST
           ) AS position
    FROM differences
)
SELECT transref, mean_anlycount,
       difference_from_overall_mean, difference_from_retained_mean
FROM ranked
WHERE position <= 10
ORDER BY difference_from_retained_mean DESC NULLS LAST
